# UPP Naval Infantry
The [bold]Naval Infantry[/bold] are the [textlink="Union of Progressive Peoples" link="CMUGuideLoreUPP"]' shock troops, its equivalent of the Colonial Marines. They are carried to war by the UPP's fleets and fight planetside wherever the Union expands.
